description.text: Main Courses English, medical English, biology, chemistry, Chinese. Fee Structure Application Fee 100USD Tuition Fee RMB17,500 in total Accommodation Fee 2500 in total Insurance Fee/ RMB 600 per /year (the university will pay 400 and students will pay 200) Visa Fee RMB 1000 (400RMB for a year) Physical Examination Fee Around RMB 500 Text Book Fee Around RMB 1000 Cost of Living RMB1, 000-2,000/month

duration.text: The Pre-medical courses at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2430 USD/In total ￥ 17500 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Curriculum Vitae You can download the sample from here. 7. Personal Statement Including personal experience,study motivation, study plan and etc. 8. Certificate of Employment(If Applicable) Any one with working experience must submit employment certificate.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport 4. With a good health and the age above 18.
